title: MamaBench: Benchmarking LLM Robustness in Maternal and Child Health Diagnosis through Counterfactual Clinical Perturbation
summary: Large language models achieve strong scores on medical benchmarks, yet these benchmarks evaluate each question in isolation, providing no measure of whether a system can distinguish clinically similar presentations requiring different interventions. We introduce MamaBench, the first counterfactual benchmark for maternal and paediatric AI: 434 expert-authored clinical narratives in 217 pairs across 371 pathologies, evaluated via the Bias Trap Rate (BTR), the conditional probability that a model fails the counterfactual given success on the base case. We propose Evidence-Anchored RAG (EA-RAG), a three-stage retrieval method that replaces aggregate similarity with an evidence coverage objective through clinical parameter extraction, coverage auditing, and contrastive sub-queries. Across eight configurations of four frontier LLMs, base accuracy overstates robust accuracy by 16-28 percentage points in every model. EA-RAG achieves 20.3% BTR and 65.0% robust accuracy on Claude Sonnet 4.6, a 5.5 percentage point BTR reduction without degrading base accuracy. The residual 20% BTR confirms that counterfactual robustness in clinical AI remains an open challenge. Keywords: counterfactual evaluation, clinical AI, maternal healthcare, retrieval-augmented generation, diagnostic robustness
tldr: Introduces MamaBench, the first counterfactual benchmark for maternal and pediatric AI, and proposes Evidence-Anchored RAG (EA-RAG) to improve LLM diagnostic robustness, achieving a 20.3% Bias Trap Rate on Claude Sonnet 4.6 while highlighting that counterfactual robustness remains an open challenge.
tldr_zh: 提出首个针对母婴AI的反事实基准测试MamaBench，并设计了基于证据锚定的检索增强生成方法（EA-RAG），在Claude Sonnet 4.6上实现了20.3%的偏差陷阱率，同时指出反事实鲁棒性仍是临床AI的未解难题。
summary_zh: 大语言模型在医学基准测试中取得了较高的得分，然而这些基准测试孤立地评估每一道题目，无法衡量系统是否能区分临床表现相似但需要不同干预措施的病例。我们提出了MamaBench——首个面向母婴AI的反事实基准测试：包含由专家撰写的434份临床叙述，构成217对病例对，涵盖371种病理，并通过偏倚陷阱率（BTR）进行评估，即模型在基础病例正确的前提下反事实病例失败的 conditional 概率。我们提出了证据锚定检索增强生成（EA-RAG），一种三阶段检索方法，通过临床参数提取、覆盖率审计和对比性子查询，以证据覆盖目标替代聚合相似度。在四种前沿大语言模型的八种配置中，每个模型的基础准确率均高估了稳健准确率16至28个百分点。EA-RAG在Claude Sonnet 4.6上实现了20.3%的BTR和65.0%的稳健准确率，BTR降低了5.5个百分点，且未降低基础准确率。残余的20% BTR证实，临床AI中的反事实稳健性仍是一个开放挑战。关键词：反事实评估，临床AI，母婴医疗，检索增强生成，诊断稳健性

title: Stitch-Inferencer: Enhance Endoscopic Video Segmentation and Tracking via Panoramic Reconstruction
summary: Surgical video understanding is fundamental to navigation systems. Endoscopic perception is often hindered by a limited field-of-view and frequent instrument occlusions, making spatio-temporal context essential for robust inference. These challenges have motivated video models that aggregate information across frames. However, existing video models typically store past observations implicitly in learned feature representations, often requiring task-specific video training, substantial annotated data, and increased computational cost. We propose Stitch-Inferencer, a real-time, model-agnostic inference framework that replaces implicit feature memory with an explicit image-space panoramic canvas. By stitching valid observations across frames, Stitch-Inferencer preserves previously observed pixels in an online, instrument-free view, expanding the effective field-of-view and providing direct access to regions that are temporarily occluded or absent from the current frame. Downstream segmentation or tracking models are applied to a compact region of interest on the panorama, and their predictions are reprojected to the current frame, enabling existing models to exploit long-range context without retraining. Experiments on anatomy segmentation and point/box tracking demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse baselines while preserving real-time throughput. The stitching module alone runs at over 60 FPS, providing a practical inference-time solution to enhance endoscopic perception in computationally constrained intraoperative environments. Source code will be made publicly available.
tldr: Stitch-Inferencer is a real-time, model-agnostic inference framework that uses an explicit panoramic canvas to stitch past observations across frames, enhancing endoscopic video segmentation and tracking without retraining, and achieving over 60 FPS.
tldr_zh: Stitch-Inferencer 是一个实时、模型无关的推理框架，通过显式的全景画布拼接各帧的过往观测，增强内窥镜视频分割与追踪，无需重新训练，且处理速度超过60 FPS。
summary_zh: 外科手术视频理解是导航系统的基础。内窥镜感知常受限于有限的视场和频繁的器械遮挡，这使得时空上下文对于鲁棒推理至关重要。上述挑战推动了能够跨帧聚合信息的视频模型的发展。然而，现有视频模型通常将历史观测隐式存储在学习的特征表示中，这往往需要特定任务的视频训练、大量标注数据以及更高的计算成本。我们提出Stitch-Inferencer——一种实时的、与模型无关的推理框架，该框架通过显式的图像空间全景画布取代隐式特征记忆。通过跨帧拼接有效观测，Stitch-Inferencer以在线方式保留先前观测到的像素，形成无器械的视野，从而扩展有效视场，并提供对当前帧中暂时被遮挡或缺失区域直接访问的能力。下游的分割或跟踪模型被应用于全景图上的紧凑感兴趣区域，其预测结果被重投影至当前帧，使现有模型无需重新训练即可利用长程上下文。在解剖分割与点/框跟踪上的实验表明，该方法在保持实时吞吐量的同时，能够在多种基线模型上实现一致提升。拼接模块单独运行速度超过60 FPS，在计算受限的术中环境中为增强内窥镜感知提供了一种实用的推理阶段解决方案。源代码将公开发布。

title: One-for-All Adaptive Radiotherapy Planning Agent: A Foundation Framework for Daily CBCT-guided Radiotherapy
summary: In this work, we introduce the One-for-All Adaptive Radiotherapy Planning Agent, a unified foundation-model-based system that performs complete, treatment-specific online adaptive planning directly from daily cone-beam CT in under two minutes. The agent first autonomously predicts all essential planning components, including synthetic CT generation, multimodal alignment, and tumor/organ segmentation. It then intelligently leverages these outputs to execute the final clinical plan design, providing a comprehensive, automated solution for daily treatment. We also demonstrate that the agent enables clinicians to define planning with intent and intervene at critical decision points, ensuring a "human-in-the-loop" framework that generates acceptable plans before final approval. Evaluated on multiple datasets spanning head-and-neck, lung, abdominal, and prostate cancers with both photon and proton therapy, the proposed framework achieves clinically acceptable accuracy and plan quality comparable to clinically generated treatment plans, with target dose errors (D98) generally within 2.0 Gy of the reference plan. The strong performance of the One-for-All agent highlights the promise of a unified foundation-model approach and opens opportunities for fast, scalable, and fully automated online adaptive radiotherapy across diverse clinical scenarios.
tldr: A unified foundation-model-based agent that performs complete online adaptive radiotherapy planning from daily CBCT in under two minutes, achieving clinically acceptable accuracy across multiple cancer types and therapy modalities.
tldr_zh: 一个基于基础模型的统一智能体，能够在两分钟内根据日常CBCT图像完成完整的在线自适应放疗计划，且在多种癌症类型和治疗模式中达到临床可接受的准确性。
summary_zh: 在此研究中，我们提出了“通用自适应放疗规划智能体”——一个基于统一基础模型的系统，能够直接从每日锥形束CT图像出发，在两分钟内完成完整且针对具体治疗方案的在线自适应规划。该智能体首先自主预测所有关键规划要素，包括合成CT生成、多模态对齐及肿瘤/器官分割；随后智能利用这些输出结果执行最终的临床计划设计，为每日治疗提供全面自动化的解决方案。我们还证明，该智能体使临床医生能够按治疗意图定义规划，并在关键决策点进行干预，确保形成“人在环中”的框架，在最终审批前生成可接受的计划。在涵盖头颈部、肺部、腹部及前列腺癌的光子与质子治疗多个数据集上的评估表明，所提框架达到了临床可接受的精度，且计划质量与临床生成的计划相当，靶区剂量误差（D98）通常控制在参考计划的2.0 Gy以内。“通用智能体”的优异性能彰显了统一基础模型方法的潜力，并为在不同临床场景中实现快速、可扩展且完全自动化的在线自适应放疗开辟了新机遇。

title: ViPSAM: Visual Prompting Medical Image Segmentation Using Segment Anything Model
summary: In proton therapy planning, respiratory-gated non-contrast CT (NCCT) is commonly used for lesion segmentation; however, accurate delineation remains challenging due to low lesion-to-background contrast. Although learning-based methods have shown strong performance, they often struggle with non-contrast image segmentation. Inspired by clinical practice, where contrast-enhanced MRI is referenced to delineate lesions on NCCT, we propose ViPSAM, a visual prompting framework that leverages complementary cross-modality information. Built upon the Segment Anything Model (SAM), ViPSAM introduces a visual prompt encoder to extract guidance features from contrast-enhanced images and a visual-guided cross-attention module to integrate non-contrast and contrast-enhanced features, thereby enhancing lesion-relevant representations in low-contrast regions. The mask decoder is further adapted in a parameter-efficient manner to utilize visual prompts effectively. We evaluate the proposed method on liver lesion segmentation using NCCT acquired for proton therapy. Experimental results demonstrate that ViPSAM outperforms representative U-Net- and SAM-based methods, indicating that cross-modality visual prompting enables more robust and accurate segmentation in non-contrast images.
tldr: ViPSAM proposes a visual prompting framework built on the Segment Anything Model (SAM) that uses contrast-enhanced MRI features to guide non-contrast CT liver lesion segmentation for proton therapy, achieving better accuracy than U-Net and standard SAM methods.
tldr_zh: ViPSAM提出了一种基于Segment Anything Model（SAM）的视觉提示框架，利用增强MRI特征引导非增强CT肝脏病灶分割，用于质子治疗规划，相比U-Net和标准SAM方法取得了更高的准确性。
summary_zh: 在质子治疗计划中，呼吸门控非对比CT（NCCT）常用于病灶分割；然而，由于病灶与背景之间的对比度较低，准确勾画仍具挑战性。尽管基于学习的方法已展现出强劲性能，但在非对比图像分割中仍常面临困难。受临床实践中参考对比增强MRI在NCCT上勾画病灶的启发，我们提出了ViPSAM——一种利用互补跨模态信息的视觉提示框架。ViPSAM基于Segment Anything模型（SAM）构建，引入视觉提示编码器以从对比增强图像中提取引导特征，并设计视觉引导交叉注意力模块以融合非对比与对比增强特征，从而增强低对比度区域中与病灶相关的表征。掩码解码器进一步以参数高效的方式进行调整，以有效利用视觉提示。我们在质子治疗中获取的NCCT肝脏病灶分割任务上评估了所提方法。实验结果表明，ViPSAM优于代表性的基于U-Net和SAM的方法，说明跨模态视觉提示能够实现更鲁棒、更准确的非对比图像分割。

title: MonteRET: AI Agent Enhancing Multimodal LLMs with Multi-granularity Knowledge Retrieval for Chest CT Report Generation
summary: Automated chest CT report generation remains challenging because clinically faithful reporting requires both whole-volume understanding and accurate description of localized anatomical findings. Here we developed and retrospectively evaluated MonteRET, a region-aware retrieval-enhanced framework for generating chest CT findings sections. MonteRET integrates global CT features with region-level anatomical representations, retrieves clinically relevant knowledge using predicted medical conditions and region-level vision-language alignment, and refines initial reports through a knowledge-guided report rewriting agent. We trained our model on a public cohort with 24,128 CT scans from RadGenome-ChestCT. We evaluated MonteRET on the public RadGenome-ChestCT test set of 1,564 CT scans and an external cohort of 82 CT scans from NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center. MonteRET improved report quality, semantic similarity, and clinical efficacy compared with a matched baseline and several state-of-the-art methods. Gains were most pronounced for recall, suggesting fewer omitted findings. Human expert evaluation by radiology residents also favored MonteRET.
tldr: MonteRET is a region-aware retrieval-enhanced framework that uses multimodal LLMs and a knowledge-guided rewriting agent to generate chest CT findings reports, achieving improved quality and clinical efficacy on public and external cohorts.
tldr_zh: MonteRET是一个区域感知的检索增强框架，利用多模态大语言模型和知识引导的改写代理生成胸部CT报告，在公共和外部队列上提升了报告质量和临床效能。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自动化胸部CT报告生成仍具挑战，因为临床可靠的报告既需要理解全肺容积，又需要准确描述局部解剖学发现。我们开发并回顾性评估了MonteRET——一种区域感知的检索增强框架，用于生成胸部CT检查所见部分。MonteRET将全局CT特征与区域级解剖表示相结合，利用预测的医学条件和区域级视觉-语言对齐检索临床相关知识，并通过知识引导的报告重写智能体优化初始报告。我们在包含24,128次CT扫描的公开队列（来自RadGenome-ChestCT）上训练了模型。在RadGenome-ChestCT公开测试集（1,564次CT扫描）和来自纽约长老会/威尔康奈尔医学中心的外部队列（82次CT扫描）上评估了MonteRET。与匹配的基线及多种前沿方法相比，MonteRET在报告质量、语义相似性和临床效能方面均有提升。召回率的提升最为显著，表明遗漏发现减少。放射科住院医师进行的人类专家评估也倾向于MonteRET。

title: Beyond scalar losses: calibrating segmentation models via gradient vector field surgery
summary: Region-based loss functions, such as the Dice loss, have established themselves as the de facto standard for highly class- and region-imbalanced segmentation tasks. However, models trained using region-based loss functions are notoriously miscalibrated and typically yield over-confident predictions. In medical imaging applications, such as defining tumor resection margins, this miscalibration is hindering clinical adoption. In this work, we outline a novel gradient perspective on this overconfidence and show how it affects region-based loss functions. We propose a "surgery" on the gradient vector field as a simple, yet effective intervention to mitigate calibration issues. This surgery adds a factor to the loss's partial derivative, scaling the gradient's magnitude linearly with the prediction error. In empirical evaluations across 2D and 3D medical segmentation tasks, we demonstrate the effectiveness of this intervention while maintaining high prediction accuracy when used in conjunction with any region-based loss function.
tldr: Proposes a gradient vector field 'surgery' to calibrate overconfident predictions from region-based segmentation losses (e.g., Dice loss) by scaling gradients linearly with prediction error, improving calibration without sacrificing accuracy in medical imaging tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种梯度向量场‘手术’方法，通过将梯度大小与预测误差线性缩放，校准区域分割损失（如Dice损失）导致的过度自信预测，在不牺牲精度的情况下改善医学图像分割的校准性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于区域的损失函数（如Dice损失）已成为高度类别与区域不平衡分割任务的事实标准。然而，使用此类损失函数训练的模型普遍存在校准不良问题，通常产生过度自信的预测。在医学影像应用（如定义肿瘤切除边缘）中，这种校准偏差阻碍了临床采纳。本研究针对该过度自信现象提出了一种新颖的梯度视角，并揭示了其如何影响基于区域的损失函数。我们提出在梯度向量场上进行“手术”，作为一种简单而有效的干预措施以缓解校准问题。该手术通过在损失的偏导数中引入一个因子，使梯度大小随预测误差线性缩放。在二维和三维医学分割任务的实证评估中，我们证明了该干预措施的有效性，且在与任何基于区域的损失函数结合使用时，仍能保持较高的预测精度。

title: 3D Geometric Tooth Alignment Planning via Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: 3D geometric tooth alignment planning, which determines sequential trajectories from initial malocclusion to the final target alignment, is a cornerstone of modern digital orthodontics. This paper presents a novel deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework to automate the generation of these alignment paths. We formulate the planning process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) to capture its sequential decision-making nature, focusing on optimizing geometric trajectories while integrating essential spatial constraints, such as inter-dental collision avoidance and path efficiency. The proposed method leverages the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm, enhanced by three key innovations: (1) a Transformer-based agent to model complex spatial interactions between teeth and manage high-dimensional state-action spaces; (2) a dynamic masking scheme that restricts movement to a sparse subset of teeth per step, better reflecting the clinical logic of sequential alignment; and (3) a two-stage curriculum learning strategy that gradually increases task difficulty to ensure training stability and efficient path discovery. We evaluate our approach on a dataset of 10K expert-designed treatment plans based on clinical data. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines in terms of path safety and geometric efficiency, providing a robust and automated solution for 3D geometric orthodontic alignment planning.
tldr: This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning framework for automated 3D tooth alignment planning, using DDPG with a Transformer-based agent, dynamic masking, and curriculum learning to optimize geometric trajectories while avoiding collisions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的3D牙齿正畸规划框架，采用DDPG算法，结合Transformer代理、动态掩码和课程学习，以优化几何轨迹并避免碰撞。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
3D几何牙齿正畸排齐规划，即确定从初始错颌畸形到最终目标排齐的连续运动轨迹，是现代数字化正畸治疗的基石。本文提出了一种新颖的深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于自动生成这些排齐路径。我们将规划过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），以捕捉其序列决策的本质，重点在优化几何轨迹的同时整合关键空间约束，例如牙间碰撞避免和路径效率。所提方法基于深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）算法，并通过三项关键创新加以增强：（1）基于Transformer的智能体，用于建模牙齿间复杂的空间交互并管理高维状态-动作空间；（2）动态掩码机制，将每一步的运动限制在稀疏的牙齿子集上，更好地反映序列排齐的临床逻辑；（3）两阶段课程学习策略，逐步增加任务难度以确保训练稳定性和高效路径发现。我们在基于临床数据的10,000个专家设计治疗计划数据集上评估了该方法。实验结果表明，我们的方法在路径安全性和几何效率方面优于现有基线，为3D几何正畸排齐规划提供了稳健且自动化的解决方案。

title: Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning For False Negative Mitigation in 3D Medical Imaging
summary: Multimodal Contrastive Learning (CL) has shown significant performance in aligning representations across various data modalities and improving downstream tasks, especially in healthcare. It works by minimizing the distance between matched (positive) data modalities, while maximizing the distance between mismatched (negative) samples. Traditional CL frameworks typically assume instance-based correspondence within data batches, treating all non-paired samples as negatives. However, this assumption often fails in medical settings, where samples may share high-level semantic attributes, leading to false negatives that degrade representation quality. In this paper, we propose Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning (MseaCL), a CL framework trained on a pediatric cohort of 3D brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans and radiology reports. The goal of this framework is to mitigate the impact of semantically similar false negative samples by incorporating semantic similarity between radiology reports, as a guiding signal during the learning process. Our results indicate that applying this framework as a pretraining stage can achieve notable improvements in downstream tasks, e.g., at least a 22.6\% increase in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of pediatric brain tumor molecular classification, demonstrating its potential for more robust and semantically aligned multimodal representations in clinical applications.
tldr: This paper proposes Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning (MseaCL) to mitigate false negatives in multimodal contrastive learning for 3D brain MRI and radiology reports, achieving significant improvements in downstream tumor classification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出多模态语义感知对比学习（MseaCL），以缓解三维脑部MRI和放射学报告的多模态对比学习中的假阴性问题，在下游肿瘤分类任务中取得了显著改进。
summary_zh: 多模态对比学习（CL）在跨多种数据模态对齐表征以及改进下游任务方面展现出显著性能，尤其在医疗领域。其原理是通过最小化匹配（正例）数据模态间的距离，同时最大化不匹配（负例）样本间的距离。传统的CL框架通常假设数据批次内存在基于实例的对应关系，将所有非配对样本视为负例。然而，这一假设在医疗场景中常常失效——样本可能共享高层语义属性，导致产生虚假负例，从而降低表征质量。本文提出多模态语义感知对比学习（MseaCL），该框架基于包含三维脑部磁共振成像（MRI）扫描影像与放射学报告的儿科队列进行训练。其目标是通过引入放射学报告间的语义相似度作为学习过程中的引导信号，减轻语义相似虚假负例样本的影响。结果表明，将该框架作为预训练阶段，能够在下游任务中取得显著提升——例如，儿童脑肿瘤分子分类的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）至少提高22.6%，展现了其在临床应用中构建更稳健且语义对齐的多模态表征的潜力。

title: Motion-Conditioned Multi-View Fusion for Myocardial Infarction Localization from Echocardiography
summary: Myocardial infarction (MI) remains a leading cause of mortality worldwide. Echocardiography (Echo) is a widely available modality for MI assessment, where regional wall motion abnormality is a key indicator. Prior learning based methods for myocardial motion analysis often use handcrafted descriptors or densely supervised estimation, but the need for extensive annotation limits applicability. Foundation models have recently improved vision-based Echo analysis; however, most methods operate on single views and segment-level localization remains unreliable under view-dependent ambiguity, especially in apical views. To address this, we propose MCF-Net, a novel motion-guided multi-view fusion framework that fuses myocardial motion cues with foundation model representations to localize infarction. Visual features are extracted using EchoPrime, a pretrained Echo foundation model shared across dual views. Cardiac motion is modeled with extremely sparse supervision: a single annotated template frame is transferred across videos to initialize point tracking, avoiding dense labels. Motion-derived segment-aware soft masks provide coarse spatial priors that selectively enhance features for challenging myocardial segments. A motion-conditioned fusion mechanism then integrates motion and vision across views, refining predictions without overriding strong appearance cues. On segment-level MI localization, MCF-Net achieves 72.4\% F1 and 84.9\% accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art motion-only, vision-only, and fusion baselines.
tldr: MCF-Net uses motion-conditioned multi-view fusion with a pretrained Echo foundation model and sparse supervision to localize myocardial infarction from echocardiography, achieving 72.4% F1 and 84.9% accuracy.
tldr_zh: MCF-Net 利用运动引导的多视图融合、预训练的 Echo 基础模型和稀疏监督对超声心动图中心肌梗死进行定位，实现了 72.4% 的 F1 分数和 84.9% 的准确率。
summary_zh: 心肌梗死（MI）仍是全球范围内的主要死亡原因。超声心动图（Echo）是一种广泛用于MI评估的检查手段，其中局部室壁运动异常是关键指标。以往基于学习的心肌运动分析方法常使用手工设计的描述符或密集监督估计，但对大量标注的需求限制了其适用性。基础模型近期提升了基于视觉的Echo分析；然而，多数方法仅处理单一切面，且节段级定位在视图依赖性模糊下仍不可靠，尤其是在心尖切面中。为解决此问题，我们提出MCF-Net，一种新颖的运动引导多视图融合框架，将心肌运动线索与基础模型表示相融合以实现梗死定位。视觉特征使用EchoPrime提取，EchoPrime是一个预训练的、在双视图中共享的Echo基础模型。心脏运动通过极稀疏监督建模：单个标注的模板帧在视频间传递以初始化点追踪，从而避免密集标注。源自运动的节段感知软掩码提供了粗略空间先验，可选择性增强具有挑战性的心肌节段的特征。随后，运动条件融合机制跨视图整合运动与视觉信息，在不覆盖强外观线索的前提下优化预测。在节段级MI定位任务上，MCF-Net达到了72.4%的F1分数和84.9%的准确率，优于最先进的仅运动、仅视觉及融合基线方法。

title: CRISP: Constrained Refinement via Iterative Squeezing Process for Robust Medical Image Segmentation under Domain Shift
summary: Distribution shift in medical imaging remains a central bottleneck for the clinical translation of medical AI. Failure to address it can lead to severe performance degradation in unseen environments and exacerbate health inequities. Existing methods for domain adaptation are inherently limited by exhausting predefined possibilities through simulated shifts or pseudo-supervision. Such strategies struggle in the open-ended and unpredictable real world, where distribution shifts are effectively infinite. To address this challenge, we adopt the "Rank Stability of Positive Regions" as a working assumption under distribution shift, and use it to derive robust spatial hints for source-only segmentation. Guided by this assumption, we propose CRISP, a model-agnostic framework that, unlike deployment-time adaptation, requires no test-time parameter updates and no target-domain data--a target-free, plug-in refinement framework that segments with frozen weights. Rather than using ranking to directly output masks, CRISP exploits the stability of probability rankings under distribution shift to derive robust spatial priors. Via latent feature perturbation, perturbation-invariant high-grade regions define a high-precision (HP) core, while voxels that remain potentially foreground under at least one perturbation define a high-recall (HR) support; these dual priors are then recursively refined under perturbation. We then design an iterative training framework that progressively squeezes HP and HR toward the final segmentation. Extensive evaluations on multi-center cardiac MRI and CT-based lung vessel segmentation demonstrate CRISP's superior robustness, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods with striking HD95 reductions of up to 0.14 (7.0% improvement), 1.90 (13.1% improvement), and 8.39 (38.9% improvement) pixels across multi-center, demographic, and modality shifts, respectively.
tldr: CRISP proposes a model-agnostic, target-free framework for robust medical image segmentation under domain shift, using rank stability of positive regions to derive spatial priors and iterative refinement without requiring target-domain data or test-time adaptation.
tldr_zh: CRISP 提出了一种模型无关、无需目标域数据的医学图像分割域自适应框架，利用正区域排名稳定性来推导空间先验并进行迭代优化，显著提升了在多种分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学影像中的分布偏移仍是医学人工智能临床转化的核心瓶颈。未能解决此问题可能导致模型在未见环境中性能严重下降，并加剧健康不平等。现有领域自适应方法因依赖通过模拟偏移或伪监督来穷举预定义可能性而固有受限。这些策略在面对开放式且不可预测的真实世界时力不从心——真实世界中的分布偏移实际上是无限的。为应对这一挑战，我们采纳“正区域排序稳定性”作为分布偏移下的工作假设，并据此推导出用于仅源域分割的鲁棒空间线索。在该假设指导下，我们提出CRISP——一种模型无关框架，与部署时自适应不同，它无需测试时参数更新，也不需要目标域数据：一种无目标、即插即用的精炼框架，使用冻结权重进行分割。CRISP并非直接利用排序输出掩膜，而是利用概率排序在分布偏移下的稳定性导出鲁棒的空间先验。通过潜在特征扰动，对扰动不变的高等级区域定义了高精度（HP）核心，而在至少一次扰动下仍可能为前景的体素定义了高召回（HR）支撑；这两种先验随后在扰动下递归精炼。接着，我们设计了一个迭代训练框架，逐步将HP和HR压缩至最终分割。在多中心心脏MRI和基于CT的肺血管分割上的大量评估表明，CRISP具有卓越的鲁棒性，显著优于现有最优方法，在多中心、人群和模态偏移下分别实现了高达0.14像素（提升7.0%）、1.90像素（提升13.1%）和8.39像素（提升38.9%）的HD95降低。

title: Self-Evolving Human-Centered Framework for Explainable Depression Symptom Annotation
summary: Annotation quality is a major bottleneck in building reliable and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) systems for mental health research. In depression-related datasets, labels are often assigned without structured evidence, symptom-level justification, or traceable alignment with the criteria of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR), limiting both transparency and downstream model interpretability. We propose a self-evolving, expert-in-the-loop annotation framework for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) that combines large language model (LLM)-assisted labeling with expert verification. The framework is intended to support the construction of explainable, DSM-5-TR-aligned datasets rather than to perform clinical diagnosis. It operates in three stages: candidate evidence selection from textual records, criterion-level DSM-5-TR analysis, and case-level synthesis that produces label-level diagnostic and severity annotations. A dual-memory architecture, composed of Example Memory and Reflection Memory, is designed to internalize expert feedback and iteratively improve future annotations without retraining. We describe this mechanism and leave its evaluation across multiple feedback cycles to future work. In addition to final labels, the framework exports clinical evidence, reasoning traces, and edit histories, enabling comprehensive auditability. In a pilot study using expert-reviewed samples, the proposed approach improves annotation consistency and explainability while reducing manual revision effort.
tldr: This paper proposes a self-evolving, expert-in-the-loop annotation framework for Major Depressive Disorder that uses LLMs and a dual-memory architecture to produce explainable, DSM-5-TR-aligned symptom labels with reasoning traces, aiming to improve annotation consistency and auditability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种自我演化、专家参与的抑郁症标注框架，利用大语言模型和双记忆架构生成可解释、符合DSM-5-TR标准的症状标签及推理轨迹，旨在提高标注一致性和可审计性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
标注质量是构建用于心理健康研究的可靠且可解释人工智能（XAI）系统的主要瓶颈。在抑郁症相关数据集中，标签通常是在缺乏结构化证据、症状级依据或与《精神障碍诊断与统计手册（第五版修订版）》（DSM-5-TR）标准可溯源对齐的情况下分配的，这限制了透明度和下游模型的可解释性。我们提出了一种针对重度抑郁症（MDD）的自演化、专家在环标注框架，该框架结合了大语言模型（LLM）辅助标注与专家验证。该框架旨在支持构建符合DSM-5-TR标准且可解释的数据集，而非执行临床诊断。它分三个阶段运行：从文本记录中筛选候选证据、进行DSM-5-TR标准级分析，以及生成标签级诊断和严重程度标注的案例级综合。一个由示例记忆和反思记忆组成的双记忆架构旨在内化专家反馈，并在无需重新训练的情况下迭代改进未来的标注。我们描述了这一机制，并将其在多个反馈循环中的评估留待未来工作。除最终标签外，该框架还导出临床证据、推理过程和编辑历史，实现全面的可审计性。在一项使用专家审核样本的初步研究中，所提出的方法提高了标注一致性和可解释性，同时减少了人工修订工作量。
